caption: The drawing shows two ceramic jars, both with a similar shape featuring slightly flared, rounded bodies, wide openings, and small handles on each side near the top. The larger jar dominates the lower central portion of the image, displaying a light grayish surface with hand-painted blue decoration. The decoration consists of a central floral or leafy motif with three main leaves or buds and additional leaves branching out. There are blue accents on the handles. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller jar rendered in similar colors. This smaller jar has blue script across the body, reading "H. Lowndes maker Petersburg Va. A.D. 1841." Both jars have shading to indicate their cylindrical form and the effect of light. The background is plain, off-white, and a rectangular border surrounds the main composition. The artist's name, "Chas. Caseau," is written in the lower left corner within the border.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
